env.description: Environment variables for the child process. Saved to persistence.json: pass secrets in ephemeralEnv instead.

ephemeralEnv.description: Environment variables injected into the child process but never persisted to persistence.json nor exposed in pane.info, pane.list or events. Pass values that must not survive a daemon restart, such as tokens, here. On respawn the caller must pass them again. Overrides env on the same key.

labels.description: Free-form labels. The daemon never interprets them. Recommended keys: owner, task, agent, origin, windowId, name. Recommended origin values: "hub", "terminal"; a pane created by `misao new` carries origin=terminal (used to discover unregistered panes). The windowId key is the hub-side window number (e.g. 806; the CLI displays it as W-806) and is unrelated to the daemon's window id. The name key is a human-readable display name.

windowId.description: Target window. Defaults to the default workspace/window.

preplace.description: Files placed in a temporary directory created outside cwd. The caller decides the content.

path.description: File path relative to the temporary directory. Absolute paths, empty / "." / ".." segments, a trailing separator, NUL and ":" (Windows drive letters) are rejected. This is only a first check: the daemon must always confirm after path.resolve that the path stays inside the temporary directory.

since.description: Last seq already received. Replays seq > since, then switches to live. Omit for live only.

epoch.description: Epoch that since belongs to. If it differs from the current epoch, the daemon returns gap: true and replays from the oldest retained item.

gap.description: True when events were missed: since is older than the retained range (since < oldest-1), since is ahead of head, or the epoch passed with since differs from the current one. A daemon restart is detected only by comparing epoch.
